title: The native derived category of pro-etale Weil sheaves and its operations
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, an algebraic closure $k$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$ and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ (Lean `PadicAlgCl ℓ`), with the topology of the absolute value extending $|\cdot|_\ell$ on $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers]: on each finite subextension $E$ it is the unique extension $|\cdot|_E$ of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and these agree on $E\subseteq E'$ by that uniqueness. For a $k_0$-scheme $W$ locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], put $\bar W=W\times_{k_0}k$ and $F_W=\operatorname{id}_W\times\operatorname{Spec}(a\mapsto a^{\#k_0})^{-1}$, geometric Galois Frobenius. Work on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $B_W$ be the sheaf of locally finite continuous $\Omega$-valued functions: on $V$ its sections are the continuous functions $t:|V|\to\Omega$, where $|V|$ is the whole underlying topological space, such that every point has a neighbourhood $N$ for which the $\mathbf Q_\ell$-span of $t(N)$ is finite dimensional, with restrictions by precomposition, and let $\mathcal A_W$ be the category of $B_W$-module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] in sheaves of $\Omega$-vector spaces, that is sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] over the constant sheaf of rings $\underline\Omega$ of the discrete ring $\Omega$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], with the monoidal structure $\otimes_{\underline\Omega}$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], of which $B_W$ (a sheaf of commutative $\Omega$-algebras under pointwise operations) is a commutative monoid (Lean `ProEtale.AdicSheaf ℓ W̄`). Let $\mathcal W_W=\mathcal A_W^{F_W^*}$ be the category of fixed pairs [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category]: a pair $(M,\phi:F_W^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}M)$, with morphisms commuting with $\phi$ (Lean `ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ ℓ W`). A sheaf in $\mathcal A_W$ is called constructible here if, locally on $\bar W$, it has a finite partition by locally closed [def-weil-locally-closed-subset] constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset] subschemes on each of which there is a pro-etale covering such that, over each covering member $U$, the restriction is $B_U^{\oplus r_U}$ for some finite rank $r_U$, allowed to depend on that member. Define
$$\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(W)=\{K\in D(\mathcal W_W):H^a(K)=0\text{ for all but finitely many }a,\ \operatorname{For}H^a(K)\text{ is constructible for every }a\}.$$
Here $D$ is the ordinary derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and the subcategory is full (Lean `WeilComplex k₀ ℓ W`). Its shifts and distinguished triangles are inherited from $D(\mathcal W_W)$ [def-weil-triangulated-category].

For a morphism $h:V\to W$ of $k_0$-schemes, use the sheaf inverse and direct images of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Precomposition of functions gives $B_W\to\bar h_*B_V$, with adjoint $\bar h^{-1}B_W\to B_V$. The module inverse image means $B_V\otimes_{\bar h^{-1}B_W}\bar h^{-1}(-)$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and module direct image uses the displayed coefficient map for its action. Open extension by zero is along an open immersion $j:U\to X$ [def-weil-open-immersion]: by [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization] $\bar U_{\mathrm{proet}}$ is the localization $\bar X_{\mathrm{proet}}/\bar U$, under which $B_{\bar X}|_{\bar U}=B_{\bar U}$ (both are the locally finite functions on the same $V$), and $j_!M$ is the sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of the extension-by-zero presheaf $P_M$ [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf] of the ringed site $(\bar X_{\mathrm{proet}},B_{\bar X})$ at $\bar U$. These three sheaf functors are equipped with their Frobenius actions via the natural inverse-image, direct-image and extension-by-zero comparisons for $\bar h F_V=F_W\bar h$. Explicitly, for any one of these sheaf functors $G:\mathcal A_S\to\mathcal A_T$, write $c:F_T^*G\xrightarrow{\sim}GF_S^*$ for its comparison. Its lift sends $(M,\phi)$ to $(GM,G(\phi)\circ c_M)$ and sends a commuting morphism $u$ to $G(u)$. Write $h^*$ for termwise inverse image on $D(\mathcal W)$, and $Rh_*$ for the total right derived functor [def-sfb-right-derived-functor] of this ordinary direct image in the abelian category of all pro-etale Weil sheaves. For separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] finite-type $h$ with $W$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], choose the same Nagata compactification as Lean `HasCompactification.compactification`, $V\xrightarrow{a}\widetilde V\xrightarrow{p}W$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and write $Rh_{0!}=R\bar p_*\bar a_!$ on these equivariant derived categories, where $\bar a_!$ is applied termwise before right derivation of $\bar p_*$. The notation on $\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}$ denotes the restriction of these actual ambient constructions when they preserve bounded constructible cohomology. These are the constructions of Lean `WeilComplex.upperStar`, `WeilComplex.derivedLowerStar`, and `WeilComplex.derivedLowerShriek`; preservation and exactness are separate assertions. No identification with the fixed pairs in $D^b_c(\bar W,\Omega)$ is stipulated.

def WeilComplex.derivedLowerShriek (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [f.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [QuasiCompact f] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] :
    WeilComplex k₀ l X ⥤ WeilComplex k₀ l Y
lean.note: Existing native framework, not fixed pairs in a derived category. LowerShriek is the public entry module importing OpenImmersion, LowerStar and Category; the primary declaration is its final compact-support operation. All coefficient, fixed-pair, ambient and restricted operations are recorded in declarations and mapped clause by clause in the report. Preservation theorems are not asserted proved by this stage-2 attachment.
